newsitem.title: USA: Berry Petroleum buys San Joaquin Production.
newsitem.headline: Berry Petroleum buys San Joaquin Production.

text.p: Berry Petroleum Co said Monday it had acquired San Joaquin Production Co for about $49.5 million cash from a major oil company. Berry did not identify the seller.
The purchase price was adjusted for cash flow received from the effective date July 1, 1996, to the closing date December 13, Berry said.

Jerry Hoffman, Berry president and chief executive, said in a statement, "We will begin full-scale development (of San Joaquin properties) in early 1997 and expect to have the properties fully integrated into our existing operations by the second quarter of 1997.
"We expect the development stage to be completed over the next 18 to 24 months.

"The combination of this acquisition with the recent Tannehill acquisition...increases Berry's total proved reserves to more than 100 million barrels, and company-wide production to approximately 12,000 barrels per day."
